items.sub: Funselektor Labs Inc. · Adventure, Casual, Racing
items.desc: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

items.name: One Million Coins
items.desc: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

items.name: How to Fish
items.desc: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

items.name: Big Dig
items.desc: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway across the Animal Republic!

items.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
items.desc: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

items.name: Alchemy Factory
items.desc: Start small, team up with friends, and automate production with conveyor belts, pipes, and magical devices. Stock your shop with potions, jewelry, and relics, complete commissions, and build an alchemy empire! Alchemy Factory 1.0 is out now with the Wagon Logistics System and revamped shopkeeping.

items.name: Space Engineers 2
items.sub: Keen Software House · Simulation, Sandbox, Action
items.desc: Space Engineers 2 is a playable Early Access Alpha sandbox focused on engineering, exploration, and colonization in a fully destructible universe. Design and build ships, stations, and planetary bases while uncovering the story of Miro and Ivan Sokol. Help shape the future of the Almagest system.

items.name: Galvatein : Adventurers' Guild
items.desc: "Welcome, adventurer! What quest have you completed today?” A classic fantasy guild reception simulation — 『Galvatein: Adventurer’s Guild』

items.name: Master of Command
items.desc: Take command in Europe's greatest 18th-century war. Equip & customize regiments, manage supplies, and engage in brutal real-time battles across procedural campaigns. Resources and replacements are scarce, and keeping your best men alive may matter more than any single victory.

items.name: IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator
items.desc: IRON NEST is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows ⟹ Will you obey High Command, Operator?

items.name: Town to City
items.desc: Build an idyllic 19th century Mediterranean town and help it flourish into a prosperous city. Freely place and customise each element to create the perfect home for your growing population in this cozy city builder from the creators of Station to Station.

items.name: Can 'Em All
items.desc: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

items.name: Tiny Eden
items.desc: A cozy first-person farming sim, set in the heart of a futuristic city. Grow plants, cook what you harvest, and discover new varieties as you turn your apartment into a thriving urban garden, from a small balcony to a rooftop paradise.

items.name: The Restoration Studio: Masterpiece Nonograms
items.desc: The Restoration Studio is a puzzle game where you restore darkened masterpieces by solving nonogram pieces. Mona Lisa, The Starry Night, Kim Hongdo’s Ssireum (Korean Wrestling), Hokusai’s The Great Wave off Kanagawa and more: 112 paintings from East and West in 2,597 puzzles, from 10×10 to 20×20.

items.name: SCROLLS: Tidy up the Library of Olympus!
items.desc: Restore order to a divine library by sorting 3,048 scattered scrolls, reuniting ancient collections, and unlocking powers worthy of Olympus. Read the markings, gather the volumes, and give the wisdom of the gods its rightful place in solo or co-op!

items.name: Silent Protocol
items.desc: Infiltrate the server in this top-down point and click 2D action game, Using precise mouse movement, Teleport and Slash your way through a series of hand-crafted levels to destroy the AI named AISEN.

items.name: Damage Numbers Go Brr!
items.desc: Damage Numbers Go Brr! is a chill incremental auto battler. Watch small numbers turn into absurdly huge numbers as you defeat enemies, get stronger, and vibe to the music while damage numbers fill your screen.

items.name: Cute Kitty WAR
items.desc: The pests have come for the yard, and the cats have had ENOUGH. Choose from 48 cats and combine 97 weapons in an arena survival game for solo or 1–4 player couch co-op. Build your arsenal, survive 12 waves of adorable mayhem, and discover what waits beyond the fence.
